meta.title: Northbridge — Q3 2026 board update
meta.description: Board update for a freight-visibility software company: answer first, KPI scorecard, one trend, a win, a miss, cash, roadmap, risks and two decisions.

slides.heading: Ahead on revenue. Late on Europe.
slides.lead: ARR closed at $48.2M, 6% over plan. We ask for two decisions to keep the lead in Q4.
slides.notes: Open with the answer. The rest of the deck is the evidence for these two sentences.

slides.heading: Revenue beat plan, Europe slipped, and two votes decide Q4
slides.body:
Won: mid-market carriers added $3.1M of new ARR.
Won: net revenue retention rose to 122%.
Missed: the Rotterdam team started 9 weeks late.
slides.aside: Decide today: approve 8 EU hires, and move $0.6M from brand to security.
slides.notes: If the board reads only one slide, it is this one.

slides.heading: Four of five KPIs beat plan; EU pipeline is the exception
ARR has beaten plan four quarters in a row
What worked, and what did not
Mid-market carriers drove two thirds of new ARR
slides.body: We cut onboarding from 21 days to 6 with the self-serve ELD connector. Carriers with 50–500 trucks now buy without a solutions engineer.
slides.aside: $3.1M of $4.7M new ARR came from mid-market. Win rate in the segment rose from 24% to 38%.

slides.heading: Europe ran 9 weeks late and cost $1.4M of pipeline
slides.left:
Rotterdam office open in June.
6 account executives selling by July.
$6.0M EU pipeline by September.
slides.right:
Office opened in August after a permit delay.
3 AEs hired, 3 still in offer stage.
$4.6M pipeline. Fix: a partner-led motion with Kestrel Freight from November.
slides.notes: Own the miss plainly. The fix is the partner motion, not more hiring alone.

slides.heading: Burn fell and runway now reaches Q2 2029

stats.label: Cash at 30 Sep, down $5.7M in the quarter
Monthly net burn, down from $2.4M in Q2
Runway at current burn, up from 26

slides.heading: Q4 turns the EU plan into a partner-led launch

steps.title: Jan · Review
steps.body: EU pipeline check at the board

slides.heading: Security review is now the top risk to Q4 renewals
rows: Diesel price spike cuts carrier budgets

slides.heading: We ask the board for two votes and one introduction

cards.title: Vote: 8 EU hires
cards.body: $1.1M in H1 to staff the partner-led motion.

cards.title: Vote: $0.6M to security
cards.body: Moved from brand spend; funds the SOC 2 audit.

cards.title: Intro: Halvard Shipping
cards.body: A warm path to their carrier network team.

slides.notes: Take the votes in this order. The intro is an ask, not a vote.

slides.heading: Fund Europe and security now to keep the lead
slides.lead: Both votes today let us start hiring on 1 December.
